say:1:1028402001:1.text: Eloran, why are you here all alone wearing such a long face?
say:1:1028402001:1.source_cn: 埃罗兰大叔，你怎么愁眉苦脸的一个人在这里？

say:2:1028402002:1.text: Ah, it's Lyca. Well, it's almost the rainy season, and for some reason, the beams of this old house have begun to rot. They can't be replaced, and my new house isn't ready yet.
say:2:1028402002:1.source_cn: 是莱卡啊。唉，雨季快到了，我这旧房子的房梁不知道为什么...

say:3:1028402003:1.text: Still short on timber! The village Harvesters have been gone more than ten days, and still no word.
say:3:1028402003:1.source_cn: 木料不够啊！村子里的采集队出去十几天了，可一点消息都没有。

say:4:1028402004:1.text: Chippy is no master carpenter, but it does take time to find nice wood, yes?
say:4:1028402004:1.source_cn: 满满不是很懂建房子，可是，要寻找合适的木料确实需要很多...

say:5:1028402005:1.text: Normally it shouldn't take this long, and they were only carrying enough supplies for ten days...
say:5:1028402005:1.source_cn: 照理说用不了这么久……他们只带了十天的补给。

say:7:1028402006:1.text: Ah, dear... I hope there hasn't been trouble. They haven't even sent anyone back for food.
say:7:1028402006:1.source_cn: 唉，也不知道是不是出什么事了，他们连个回来补充食物的人...

say:8:1028402007:1.text: More than ten days without news? No, something definitely seems off.
say:8:1028402007:1.source_cn: 十几天都没回来，而且还没有任何消息？嗯……这确实不对劲。

say:9:1028402008:1.text: Lyca, if you have time, would you try and find them?
say:9:1028402008:1.source_cn: 莱卡……你们如果有空的话，能不能去找找他们？

say:10:1028402009:1.text: I can't stop worrying about the Harvesters and the new house, but... I'm afraid of wild beasts.
say:10:1028402009:1.source_cn: 我担心采集队的人，又惦记我那新房子……可我实在是害怕外...

say:11:1028402010:1.text: In recent days, Vaduso hasn't been entirely placid.
say:11:1028402010:1.source_cn: 最近的瓦度索，实在是不太平呐……

say:12:1028402011:1.text: Don't worry, Eloran, we'll get to the bottom of it.
say:12:1028402011:1.source_cn: 放心吧，埃罗兰叔叔，我们这就去看看情况。

say:14:1028402013:1.text: <style="highlight">The patch of forest north of the village.</style> You'll see it soon if you keep heading north along the road.

say:0:1028403001:0.text: The woods north of the village, huh? Hmm... should be this way!
say:0:1028403001:0.source_cn: 村子北边的森林。嗯……应该是，这个方向！

say:1:1028403002:0.text: Wow, Chippy actually found the right path this time!
say:1:1028403002:0.source_cn: 呀，满满这次倒是找对了路呢！

say:1:1028404001:1.text: The Harvesters should be nearby... Wait, where did all the trees go?!
say:1:1028404001:1.source_cn: 采集队应该就在这附近吧。咦？这里的树呢……怎么全没了？！

say:2:1028404002:1.text: This just isn't right. How could they have felled every last tree?
say:2:1028404002:1.source_cn: 这……不对，他们怎么会把所有的树都砍伐了呢？

choice_prompt:3:1028404002.text: This just isn't right. How could they have felled every last tree?
choice_prompt:3:1028404002.source_cn: 这……不对，他们怎么会把所有的树都砍伐了呢？

say:5:1028404003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! the Wilders have always respected nature. They would never chop down any trees that hadn't matured!
say:5:1028404003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! the Wilders have always respected nature. They would never chop down any trees that hadn't matured!
say:5:1028404003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is right! the Wilders have always respected nature. They would never chop down any trees that hadn't matured!

say:6:1028404006:1.text: All the lumber is piled up over here, but the Harvesters are nowhere to be found...
say:6:1028404006:1.source_cn: 采集队砍下来的木材堆在这里，人却不见了……

say:8:1028404008:1.source_cn: 主人，我们在周围调查一下看看吧！

say:10:1028404004:1.text: Could it be they were forced to? Whoever did this even cut down the saplings—it'll take ages for the forest to recover from this. This isn't our way.
say:10:1028404004:1.source_cn: 难道……有人强迫他们？连生长年份这么短的小树都伐掉了，...

say:11:1028404005:1.text: Forced into felling all the trees? The forest is closed off, and timber can't even be moved out. So, who would do something like this?!
say:11:1028404005:1.source_cn: 强迫砍树？现在丛林封锁了，木材也运不出去，谁会干这种事！

say:1:1028405001:1.text: Well, these trees were all felled in the last few days. The cuts are fresh, and there's even sawdust piled around.
say:1:1028405001:1.source_cn: 嗯……这些树都是这几天砍掉的，痕迹很新，还有木屑呢。

say:2:1028405002:1.text: These marks are definitely from the tools we typically use. Could this really be the work of the Harvesters?
say:2:1028405002:1.source_cn: 看这锯痕，确实像是我们常用的伐木工具。难道真的是那支采...

say:3:1028405003:2.text: Wait, these stumps look a bit odd...
say:3:1028405003:2.source_cn: 咦，这些树桩看起来有些奇怪……

choice_prompt:4:1028405003.text: Wait, these stumps look a bit odd...
choice_prompt:4:1028405003.source_cn: 咦，这些树桩看起来有些奇怪……

say:6:1028405005:1.text: The stumps do appear to show signs of corruption, but it doesn't seem too severe... strange.
say:6:1028405005:1.source_cn: ……这些被砍伐的树确实有腐化的迹象，但看起来都不严重。...

say:7:1028405006:1.text: What's so strange? The forest is full of corruption now!
say:7:1028405006:1.source_cn: 哪里奇怪？现在丛林里到处都是腐化！

say:8:1028405007:1.text: The corruption in northern Taran is indeed severe, but the signs of it here are quite mild, as if they've only just manifested...
say:8:1028405007:1.source_cn: 塔兰村北腐化得那么严重，这里的迹象却很轻微，像是刚刚开...

say:9:1028405008:1.text: Let's discuss this later. Our top priority is to find the Harvesters.
say:9:1028405008:1.source_cn: 这个稍后再讨论吧，当务之急还是先找到那支采集队才是。

say:2:1028406001:1.text: Here, here! Look! Lots of tracks from people passing through!
say:2:1028406001:1.source_cn: 这里、这里……快看，有很多人走过的痕迹！

say:3:1028406002:1.text: So many footprints... Chippy is right, it looks like a group stopped here.
say:3:1028406002:1.source_cn: 这么多脚印……满满说得没错，看起来像是有一支队伍在这里...

say:4:1028406003:1.text: We should be able to follow the tracks and find them, right?
say:4:1028406003:1.source_cn: 我们跟着脚印应该就能找到这些人了吧？

say:5:1028406004:1.text: Watch your step, we don't want to mess up any of these footprints!
say:5:1028406004:1.source_cn: 那是当然……哎呀，细心点，不要破坏了这些脚印！

say:2:1028407001:1.text: Did the Harvesters get scared away by wild, corrupted glimmerblooms?
say:2:1028407001:1.source_cn: 对呀！你们说，采集队的人会不会是被这些腐化花妖给吓跑了？

say:3:1028407002:1.text: They couldn't win, so maybe they ran deeper into the forest to hide and wait for help!
say:3:1028407002:1.source_cn: 他们打不过，只能逃跑，慌不择路地跑到了森林深处，躲了起...

say:4:1028407003:1.text: If we follow the footprints, we can rescue them!
say:4:1028407003:1.source_cn: 跟着留下的脚印，就能找到他们，把采集队救出来！

say:7:1028407005:1.text: Hmm... well, Chippy is right about one thing—if we follow the footprints, we'll get some answers.
say:7:1028407005:1.source_cn: 嗯……不过满满有一样说得很对，跟着脚印，就能知道采集队...

say:8:1028407006:1.text: What are we waiting for? Let's go!

choice:6:0:1.text: There are no signs of a fight.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 附近没有任何战斗的痕迹
choice:6:0:1.male: There are no signs of a fight.
choice:6:0:1.female: There are no signs of a fight.

say:0:1028408001:0.text: The tracks lead straight through here! Follow me!
say:0:1028408001:0.source_cn: 脚印沿着这个方向走了！快点快点，我来带路！

say:1:1028408002:0.text: Careful, there may be more corrupted creatures ahead!
say:1:1028408002:0.source_cn: 小心点，前面说不定又有被腐化影响的生物！

say:1:1028411001:1.text: You there... wait, I've seen you before! You're from the Dark Forest, yes?
say:1:1028411001:1.source_cn: 你们是……等等，我好像见过你们！你们是从薄暮丛林来的，对吧？

say:2:1028411002:1.text: My name is Theodore, and I'm the captain of the Harvesters.
say:2:1028411002:1.source_cn: 我叫西奥多，是采集队的队长。

say:3:1028411003:1.text: You've been gone for so long without any news that the people of Taran are worried sick. Have you run into any trouble?
say:3:1028411003:1.source_cn: 你们这么久没有音讯，塔兰村里的人很着急，是遇到什么问题了吗？

say:4:1028411004:1.text: Any trouble? We've had nothing BUT trouble.
say:4:1028411004:1.source_cn: 遇到什么问题？我们遇到的全都是问题！

say:5:1028411005:2.text: First, we ran into two <style="highlight">grouchy herbalists</style> who adamantly opposed us harvesting any timber.
say:5:1028411005:2.source_cn: 先是在这里遇到<style=highlight>两个古...

say:6:1028411006:1.text: Wasn't easy to persuade them. Then, overnight, <style="highlight">the trees showed signs of corruption,</style> which quickly spread throughout the entire forest.
say:6:1028411006:1.source_cn: 好容易说服了他们，一夜之间，<style=highli...

say:7:1028411007:1.text: The herbalists said the corruption couldn't be eradicated, so I made a tough call... had the team cut down all the corrupted trees.
say:7:1028411007:1.source_cn: 植物学家说腐化无法清除，没办法，我只好……只好让队员把...

say:8:1028411008:1.text: By Misarte above, we would never intentionally harm the forest! We were just trying to slow the spread of corruption.
say:8:1028411008:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒有灵！我们并不想破坏林场生态，只是希望可以延缓腐...

say:9:1028411009:1.text: So that explains it... no wonder you even cut down the saplings.
say:9:1028411009:1.source_cn: 原来是这样……怪不得你们连小树都伐掉了。

say:10:1028411010:1.text: I feel terrible, but what else could we do? And now it doesn't even seem we've solved the root of the problem.
say:10:1028411010:1.source_cn: 我也心疼啊，可又有什么办法？但谁知道，这法子压根不治本。

say:11:1028411011:1.text: Even after cutting the affected trees, the corruption is still slowly spreading. Those herbalists are a joke!
say:11:1028411011:1.source_cn: 即便砍掉了被腐化的树，腐化仍然在慢慢蔓延，那两个植物学...

say:12:1028411012:1.text: And alas, our troubles are far from over. In the past few days, our group has been falling ill one after another!
say:12:1028411012:1.source_cn: 唉……这还不算完。就这几天，我们队伍里的人也陆续生病了！

say:13:1028411013:1.text: We're all weak, can't eat... the state of the forest aside, we can barely walk...
say:13:1028411013:1.source_cn: 大家都吃不下东西，虚弱无力，别说紧急抢救林场了，现在连...

say:14:1028411014:1.text: We've just had terrible luck all around!

say:16:1028411015:1.text: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!
say:16:1028411015:1.source_cn: 别担心，让我的主人来为帮你们检查一下吧！<style=...
say:16:1028411015:1.male: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!
say:16:1028411015:1.female: Don't worry, let my magister investigate！<style="stress"><player_name></style>, there must be something we can do!

say:2:1028412001:1.text: Huh? Who's there? Don't... don't disturb my rest.

say:3:1028412002:1.text: Are you alright? Do you need something to eat?
say:3:1028412002:1.source_cn: 你还好吗？要不要吃点东西？

say:4:1028412003:1.source_cn: 没力气，不吃……只想睡觉……呼呼……呼……

choice_prompt:5:1028412003.source_cn: 没力气，不吃……只想睡觉……呼呼……呼……

say:6:1028412004:1.text: Hmm... general fatigue and weakness, loss of appetite... his tongue appears purple and his complexion has a blue tint.
say:6:1028412004:1.source_cn: 症状是全身疲乏无力，没有食欲。嗯，舌苔发紫，脸色发青……

say:7:1028412005:1.text: His fatigue is definitely due to the corruption, but his symptoms appear mild.
say:7:1028412005:1.source_cn: 应该是受到腐化侵蚀的原因，很轻微，所以他只表现出了乏力...

choice_prompt:8:1028412005.text: His fatigue is definitely due to the corruption, but his symptoms appear mild.
choice_prompt:8:1028412005.source_cn: 应该是受到腐化侵蚀的原因，很轻微，所以他只表现出了乏力的症状。

choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 很明显的症状，漫漫你来说

say:2:1028413001:1.text: How do you feel? Are you also weak and tired?
say:2:1028413001:1.source_cn: 你感觉怎么样，也是全身乏力吗？

say:3:1028413002:1.text: Look, I used to be the strongest of us, but now even walking is tiring me out!
say:3:1028413002:1.source_cn: 你瞧瞧，以前我是队伍里最壮的！现在可好，连走路都累。

say:4:1028413003:1.text: What kind of dreadful illness is this? Misarte, please help me recover.
say:4:1028413003:1.source_cn: 唉，这到底是什么病啊。弥萨忒在上，赶紧让我好起来吧。

say:5:1028413004:1.text: General weakness and pronounced blue veins... indeed these are more signs of corruption sickness.
say:5:1028413004:1.source_cn: 嗯，全身乏力，血管发青……确实是一样的腐化侵蚀症状。

say:1:1028414001:1.text: These Harvesters are all indeed experiencing corruption sickness, but fortunately, their symptoms are relatively mild.
say:1:1028414001:1.source_cn: 这些采集队员的确是被腐化侵蚀了，还好都很轻微。

say:2:1028414002:1.text: Well, let's look for some herbs nearby!
say:2:1028414002:1.source_cn: 那，我们在附近找找药草吧！

say:3:1028414003:1.text: But only uncorrupted herbs will cure them, right? I'm afraid we won't find what we need here.
say:3:1028414003:1.source_cn: 可是只有没被污染的药材才能治愈腐化呀？而且这里恐怕找不...

choice_prompt:4:1028414003.text: But only uncorrupted herbs will cure them, right? I'm afraid we won't find what we need here.
choice_prompt:4:1028414003.source_cn: 可是只有没被污染的药材才能治愈腐化呀？而且这里恐怕找不全所有的药……

say:5:1028414004:1.text: Well, if we just want to relieve symptoms, let's go to the edge of the forest and try to find herbs far from the corruption. That might work.
say:5:1028414004:1.source_cn: 唔……好吧，如果只是让症状得到缓解，我们去林场边缘，尽...

say:7:1028414005:1.text: As long as the Harvesters can walk, they can get to a safer place for follow-up treatment.
say:7:1028414005:1.source_cn: 嗯，只要采集队的队员能走得动路，就可以返回安全的地方，...

say:8:1028414006:1.text: Given the circumstances, it's best they leave the forest sooner than later.
say:8:1028414006:1.source_cn: 现在这种情况，他们还是早点离开林场更安全。

say:9:1028414007:1.text: Okay, let's go find the herbs!
say:9:1028414007:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯，咱们这就去找药草吧！

choice:4:0:1.text: We just need to ease symptoms.
choice:4:0:1.male: We just need to ease symptoms.
choice:4:0:1.female: We just need to ease symptoms.

choice:4:1:2.text: Let's just make do for now.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 凑合凑合吧，我们要找出真相
choice:4:1:2.male: Let's just make do for now.
choice:4:1:2.female: Let's just make do for now.

say:0:1028415001:0.text: This one here, and... oh, that one! Yes, all of these can be used.
say:0:1028415001:0.source_cn: 这个、还有这个……这些药草都可以用。

say:1:1028415002:0.text: Luckily, although we've only found a few, they should be enough to ease their conditions.
say:1:1028415002:0.source_cn: 还好，虽然只能找到这几样，但应该可以缓解他们的症状了。

say:1:1028416001:1.text: *Yawn* Who is it? Let me sleep...

say:2:1028416002:1.text: Sleep all you want, but only after some medicine!
say:2:1028416002:1.source_cn: 睡，可以睡，吃了药随便睡！

say:3:1028416003:1.text: You need to eat these herbs!
say:3:1028416003:1.source_cn: 先把我们找到的药草吃下去！

choice_prompt:4:1028416003.text: You need to eat these herbs!
choice_prompt:4:1028416003.source_cn: 先把我们找到的药草吃下去！

say:5:1028416004:1.text: What is this... huh? So spicy! *Cough*
say:5:1028416004:1.source_cn: 什么东西……唔，好辣！咳、咳咳……

say:6:1028416005:1.text: Such an intense flavor... huh? I don't feel tired now!
say:6:1028416005:1.source_cn: 好刺激的味道……嗯？好像不那么困倦了。

say:7:1028416006:1.text: I'm so hungry! How long as it been since I last ate?
say:7:1028416006:1.source_cn: 好饿啊……我多久没吃东西了？

say:1:1028417001:1.text: It's you again... what is it now? I have no energy, so please don't try and put me up to anything.
say:1:1028417001:1.source_cn: 又是你们……还有什么事吗？先说好，我真的没力气，别让我...

say:2:1028417002:1.text: Please try these herbs, they should help you regain some strength.
say:2:1028417002:1.source_cn: 请试试这些草药，应该可以让你恢复一些气力。

say:3:1028417003:1.text: Can you really heal us? Blessed Misarte, I hope this works!
say:3:1028417003:1.source_cn: 你们能治疗我们身上的病？弥萨忒保佑，希望有效果。

say:4:1028417004:1.text: The flavor is a bit odd...

say:5:1028417005:1.text: I feel so light and relaxed! I can even hold my axe again!
say:5:1028417005:1.source_cn: ……感觉身上轻松了，也能拿动斧子了……

say:6:1028417006:1.text: Thank you! Misarte herself must have sent you!
say:6:1028417006:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！你们一定是弥萨忒派来的使者！

say:7:1028417007:1.text: ...Maybe not Misarte, but if it works, it works!
say:7:1028417007:1.source_cn: ……也不一定是弥萨忒，不过，有用就好！

say:1:1028418001:1.source_cn: 太好了，你们的药真的很有效！

say:2:1028418002:1.text: Although your symptoms should be temporarily eased, it's best that you leave and seek further treatment somewhere safe.
say:2:1028418002:1.source_cn: 虽然现在可以暂时缓解症状，但你们最好先远离这片林场，找...

say:3:1028418003:1.text: Many thanks for your help. We'll gather ourselves and head off soon, but there's one more thing...
say:3:1028418003:1.source_cn: 多谢你们的帮助，我们休整一下就回去。但还有一件事……

say:5:1028418005:1.text: Ah, Chippy almost forgot about those two! Where are they?
say:5:1028418005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，满满差点忘了这两个人了！他们人呢，没有在你们的营地吗？

say:6:1028418006:1.source_cn: 他们……我也不知道他们在哪里。

say:7:1028418007:1.text: When I realized that cutting down the trees wouldn't stem the corruption, I wrote a letter calling for aid from the people of Taran.
say:7:1028418007:1.source_cn: 唉，发现砍树无法阻绝腐化的时候，我给塔兰村里的人写了封...

say:9:1028418008:1.text: The herbalists claimed they couldn't continue their research because of the corruption and offered to deliver the letter for us.
say:9:1028418008:1.source_cn: 当时，那两个植物学家说腐化出现，没办法继续研究，自告奋...

say:10:1028418009:1.text: We haven't received a reply, and according to you, the village hasn't gotten any word at all!
say:10:1028418009:1.source_cn: 我们一直没等到回信。而且听你们的意思，村里根本没收到我...

choice_prompt:11:1028418009.text: We haven't received a reply, and according to you, the village hasn't gotten any word at all!
choice_prompt:11:1028418009.source_cn: 我们一直没等到回信。而且听你们的意思，村里根本没收到我们的消息！

say:12:1028418010:1.text: That's what I'm worried about! What if they ran into corrupted beasts?
say:12:1028418010:1.source_cn: 我就担心这个！万一他们碰到了被腐化影响的野兽……

say:13:1028418011:1.text: Two academic types unequipped to defend themselves could spell serious trouble!
say:13:1028418011:1.source_cn: 两个搞研究的学者，肩不能扛手不能提的，要是真遇上野兽就...

say:15:1028418014:1.text: Don't feel guilty, the situation was chaotic. Just take care of your group and we'll find the herbalists.
say:15:1028418014:1.source_cn: 当时毕竟情况紧急。你别着急，请照看好队员，我们会去寻找...

say:16:1028418015:1.text: We're so lucky you arrived to treat us and find our people. Thank you so much!
say:16:1028418015:1.source_cn: 还好你们来了，又帮我们治病，还帮我们找人，太感谢了！

say:17:1028418016:1.text: We escorted the two herbalists to the crossroads outside of camp before parting ways.
say:17:1028418016:1.source_cn: 分别时，我们送那两个植物学家出了营地，直到路口，然后就...

say:18:1028418017:1.text: Please be careful along the way!

say:20:1028418013:1.text: It's possible. Ugh, someone should've been sent as a guide.
say:20:1028418013:1.source_cn: 有可能，唉，当时应该派个人给他们带路的……

say:1:1028419001:0.text: Theodore said they escorted the herbalists here before they split off.
say:1:1028419001:0.source_cn: 西奥多说他把两位植物学家送到了这个路口，才和他们分开的。

say:2:1028419002:1.text: Strange... when looking for the Harvesters earlier, Chippy didn't see any footprints heading toward Taran.
say:2:1028419002:1.source_cn: 奇怪，之前找采集队的时候，满满没看到有足迹往塔兰村去。

say:3:1028419003:1.text: There are a ton of footprints, sure you didn't make a mistake?
say:3:1028419003:1.source_cn: 明明路上有很多足迹，你是不是看错了？

say:4:1028419004:1.text: Chippy wouldn't make a mistake like that! Chippy is a world-class tracker!
say:4:1028419004:1.source_cn: 满满才不会看错呢！方向满满还是能认清楚！

say:5:1028419005:2.text: Could it be they took the wrong path and got lost?
say:5:1028419005:2.source_cn: ……难道那两位植物学家难道真走错了路，跑到更远的岔路上了？

say:6:1028419006:1.text: How could they get lost? Are they even locals? Chippy could find his way back to Taran blindfolded!
say:6:1028419006:1.source_cn: 这样都能迷路，他们还是不是本地人？连满满都还记得回塔兰...

say:7:1028419007:1.text: Chippy is right... Wilder herbalists are quite familiar with the forest, so there's really no reason for them to get lost.
say:7:1028419007:1.source_cn: ……满满说的其实有些道理，绿裔的植物学者常年泡在森林里...

say:8:1028419008:1.text: Let's just try to find them.
say:8:1028419008:1.source_cn: 不过，我们还是先去找人吧。

say:0:1028420001:0.text: Look, hypofiends! They're appearing in large groups because of the corruption!
say:0:1028420001:0.source_cn: 你们看，又是魔物！一定是因为腐化的关系，它们开始大量出现了！

say:1:1028420002:0.text: Maybe the herbalists also ran into them, and that's why they couldn't deliver the letter to Taran?!
say:1:1028420002:0.source_cn: 难道植物学家也遇上了魔物，才没能回到塔兰村送信？！

say:0:1028421001:0.text: Huh? There's no path ahead, just a giant tree...
say:0:1028421001:0.source_cn: 咦？前面没有路了，只有一棵大树……

say:1:1028421002:0.text: There seem to be footprints near the tree! Let's take a look.
say:1:1028421002:0.source_cn: 树前面好像有脚印，我们去看看！

say:1:1028422001:1.text: These prints look completely different from the Harvesters'! Certainly, they belong to someone else!
say:1:1028422001:1.source_cn: 这里的脚印，和采集队成员的脚印完全不同！是另一种足迹！

say:2:1028422002:1.text: One person's steps are large, and their feet appear to point outward. The other takes small, awkward steps.
say:2:1028422002:1.source_cn: 一个人步伐很大，走路有点外八字；另一个似乎步伐比较小，...

choice_prompt:3:1028422002.text: One person's steps are large, and their feet appear to point outward. The other takes small, awkward steps.
choice_prompt:3:1028422002.source_cn: 一个人步伐很大，走路有点外八字；另一个似乎步伐比较小，感觉走得踉踉跄跄的……

say:4:1028422003:2.text: What's odd is that their tracks end here. They neither continue nor double back...
say:4:1028422003:2.source_cn: 奇怪，他们的脚印在这里消失了……没有往回走，也没有去别...

say:5:1028422004:1.text: Maybe they were chased by a hypofiend and had to climb the tree!
say:5:1028422004:1.source_cn: 难道被怪物追赶，到这里无路可跑，所以不得不爬到了树上！

say:6:1028422005:1.text: Hey! Up above! Is anyone there?!

say:7:1028422006:1.text: No, the moss on the tree is still intact, with no signs of climbing.
say:7:1028422006:1.source_cn: 不对，树干上的青苔都很完整，没有被踩踏或者蹭掉的痕迹。

say:10:1028422008:0.text: In general, people don't just disappear without a trace!
say:10:1028422008:0.source_cn: 漫漫能肯定，人是不会凭空消失的！

choice_prompt:11:1028422008.text: In general, people don't just disappear without a trace!
choice_prompt:11:1028422008.source_cn: 漫漫能肯定，人是不会凭空消失的！

say:12:1028422009:1.text: Huh?! This tree has a hidden entrance!
say:12:1028422009:1.source_cn: 这棵树……居然是个隐秘的入口！

say:13:1028422010:0.text: Let me take a look... ohh, it's so dark inside! I wonder where it leads.
say:13:1028422010:0.source_cn: 我看看……呀，里面好黑啊！不知道通往什么地方……

say:14:1028422011:1.text: Hammie, are you scared? Don't worry, you can hide behind my shield!
say:14:1028422011:1.source_cn: 漫漫害怕了吗？别担心，你可以躲到我的盾牌后面！

say:15:1028422012:0.text: Sc-scared? No way! Let's go together!
say:15:1028422012:0.source_cn: 谁……谁怕黑啊！我们一起去！

choice:11:1:2.text: Let me check for magic traces.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 让我来侦测魔法的痕迹吧
choice:11:1:2.male: Let me check for magic traces.
choice:11:1:2.female: Let me check for magic traces.

choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 有很多种魔法可以让人失去踪迹

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 应该是那两个植物学家

say:0:1028424001:0.text: There are footprints here, too. Same as outside.
say:0:1028424001:0.source_cn: 这里也有脚印……形状和外面的一样。
say:0:1028424001:0.male: There are footprints here, too. Same as outside.
say:0:1028424001:0.female: There are footprints here, too. Same as outside.

say:1:1028424002:0.text: Seems the herbalists really did come here to hide!
say:1:1028424002:0.source_cn: 看来那两个植物学家果然躲到这里来了！

say:0:1028424101:0.text: Oh, no! Hypofiends! Chippy hopes the herbalists are okay...
say:0:1028424101:0.source_cn: 糟糕，这里有魔物！植物学家不会遭遇不测了吧……

say:0:1028425001:0.text: Magister, look—people ahead! Let's go see!
say:0:1028425001:0.source_cn: 主人，你看，前面有人！我们去问问吧。
say:0:1028425001:0.male: Magister, look—people ahead! Let's go see!
say:0:1028425001:0.female: Magister, look—people ahead! Let's go see!

say:1:1028425002:0.text: Careful, we don't know who cast the spell over the entrance.
say:1:1028425002:0.source_cn: 嗯，但要小心，不知道洞穴入口是被谁施法掩蔽起来的。
say:1:1028425002:0.male: Careful, we don't know who cast the spell over the entrance.
say:1:1028425002:0.female: Careful, we don't know who cast the spell over the entrance.

say:2:1028426002:1.text: My name is Lyca of the Dusk Patrollers. Are you the two herbalists who parted ways with the Harvesters?
say:2:1028426002:1.source_cn: 我是薄暮巡游队的莱卡，你们是从采集队营地出发的那两位植...

say:3:1028426003:1.text: Wait, why is your companion on the ground? Is he alright?
say:3:1028426003:1.source_cn: 咦……为什么你的同伴躺在地上？！他没事吗？！

say:4:1028426004:1.text: D-d-dusk Patrollers? I see. Oh, he, um... he's petrified! Scared stiff!
say:4:1028426004:1.source_cn: 巡……巡游队啊，哦，对，他是……吓坏了！对，吓晕了！

say:5:1028426005:1.text: Hypofiends were chasing us so we ran and ran and well... he just sort of... passed out?
say:5:1028426005:1.source_cn: 外面有魔物追击，我们一路逃……对，然后他……他就晕过去了！

say:6:1028426006:1.text: Are you unwell? Why are you stuttering?
say:6:1028426006:1.source_cn: 你不舒服吗？为什么结结巴巴的？

say:7:1028426007:1.source_cn: 我……咳，我是有点不舒服……咳咳！

say:8:1028426008:1.text: How long has your companion been unconscious? Do you need our help?
say:8:1028426008:1.source_cn: 你的同伴晕过去多久了？需要我们帮忙吗？

say:9:1028426009:1.text: Ah? Oh, no... he, uh, should wake up... some time...
say:9:1028426009:1.source_cn: 啊？哦，不，没事……他……他应该过一会就能醒过来……

choice_prompt:10:1028426009.text: Ah? Oh, no... he, uh, should wake up... some time...
choice_prompt:10:1028426009.source_cn: 啊？哦，不，没事……他……他应该过一会就能醒过来……

say:11:1028426010:1.text: Sir, I'd like to know more about your situation...
say:11:1028426010:1.source_cn: 先生，我想再多了解一下你们之前遇到的状况……

narration:12:1028426011:1.text: As Lyca speaks to the herbalists, Chippy uses the shadows on the wall to sneak to the side of the table.

say:14:1028426012:1.source_cn: 这是……主人，我拿回来了，你们看！

say:15:1028426013:1.text: Hey! You dirty rat! Don't touch my things!
say:15:1028426013:1.source_cn: ——喂！肮脏的耗子！别碰我的东西！

say:16:1028426014:1.text: Is that... the letter of aid from the Harvesters?
say:16:1028426014:1.source_cn: 这是……采集队写给村子的求助信？

say:17:1028426015:1.text: Why did you open the letter without permission?!
say:17:1028426015:1.source_cn: 你们……你为什么私自把信拆开了？！

say:18:1028426016:0.text: How did your companion truly come to faint? Answer honestly!
say:18:1028426016:0.source_cn: 你的同伴到底是怎么昏倒的，请诚实地回答！

say:19:1028426017:1.text: Hmph... I thought I could handle things, but you people certainly are persistent.
say:19:1028426017:1.source_cn: 哼……本来还想着能应付过去的，你们这些人真是麻烦！

say:20:1028426018:1.text: You'll only have yourselves to blame for poking your nose where it doesn't belong...
say:20:1028426018:1.source_cn: 非要问那么多问题，这只能怪你们自己——

say:22:1028426020:1.text: Oh, no! Hypofiends are closing in!
say:22:1028426020:1.source_cn: 糟了，周围有魔物围过来了……！

say:1:1028427001:0.text: So you've shown your true colors... you're not an herbalist at all!
say:1:1028427001:0.source_cn: 好呀，原来这才是你的真面目，你根本不是植物学家！

say:4:1028427003:0.text: It's high time you came clean.
say:4:1028427003:0.source_cn: 先生，你现在可以说实话了吧！

say:5:1028427004:0.text: I... I'm with the Adamant Syndicate. Look, here's an antidote to wake the herbalist.
say:5:1028427004:0.source_cn: 我、我是黑金商会的……别动手，给，这是能让那个植物学家...

say:6:1028427005:0.text: I took away his child and forced him to work for me.
say:6:1028427005:0.source_cn: 我带走了他的孩子，胁迫他和我合作……

choice_prompt:7:1028427005.text: I took away his child and forced him to work for me.
choice_prompt:7:1028427005.source_cn: 我带走了他的孩子，胁迫他和我合作……

say:8:1028427006:0.text: I've kept her locked up... don't hit me! I'll tell you where she is!
say:8:1028427006:0.source_cn: 我把他的孩子关起来了……我会把地方告诉你们！别、别打！

say:9:1028427007:0.text: What exactly are you doing here?!
say:9:1028427007:0.source_cn: 你们到底在这里做什么？！

say:10:1028427008:0.text: Well, researching and experimenting with... corruption.

choice_prompt:11:1028427008.text: Well, researching and experimenting with... corruption.

say:12:1028427009:0.text: Yes, it was me. Who would've thought such a remote forest would see so many people...
say:12:1028427009:0.source_cn: 是我，谁知道那么偏僻的地方，突然来了一队人……

say:13:1028427013:0.text: We can't let him go! Magister, let's just...
say:13:1028427013:0.source_cn: 不行！不能放过他！主人，我们干脆把他——
say:13:1028427013:0.male: We can't let him go! Magister, let's just...
say:13:1028427013:0.female: We can't let him go! Magister, let's just...

say:14:1028427014:0.text: Huh? No, don't! I've already told you everything! Help! Please!
say:14:1028427014:0.source_cn: 哎？别……别别……我、我都说了，都说了啊！救命！求求你！

say:15:1028427015:0.text: Tie him up! We'll have a patrol team take him away!
say:15:1028427015:0.source_cn: ——把他绑起来！叫巡游队把他带走！

say:17:1028427017:1.text: Oh, he'll get what he deserves. Let's wake up the real herbalist.
say:17:1028427017:1.source_cn: 巡游队会给他应有的待遇，我们先把那位真正的植物学家救醒吧。

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 林场的腐化是你做的吧

say:19:1028427010:0.text: Well, besides studying how the forest would be corrupted, naturally we had to see how other local organisms would respond to corruption.
say:19:1028427010:0.source_cn: 研究嘛，除了研究森林腐化，当然也要研究当地生物被腐化侵...

say:20:1028427011:0.text: The Harvesters just so happened to arrive and... well, their ailments weren't too severe...
say:20:1028427011:0.source_cn: 这不刚好那些采集队来了……而且，事实上也没有造成很严重...

choice:11:1:2.text: What about the illness of the Harvesters?
choice:11:1:2.male: What about the illness of the Harvesters?
choice:11:1:2.female: What about the illness of the Harvesters?

choice:7:1:2.text: You used a child as collateral?!
choice:7:1:2.male: You used a child as collateral?!
choice:7:1:2.female: You used a child as collateral?!

say:1:1028428001:1.text: I... uh... who are you folks?

say:2:1028428002:1.text: Don't be afraid, we're the good guys! We defeated that nasty Adamant Syndicate villain!
say:2:1028428002:1.source_cn: 不要害怕，我们是好人！我们把那个黑金的坏人打败了，你看！

say:4:1028428004:1.text: Please, save my child! He's kidnapped my child!
say:4:1028428004:1.source_cn: 求你们救救我的孩子！他把我的孩子绑走了！

say:5:1028428005:1.text: Don't worry, he's confessed to everything. I assure you your child will return home safely.
say:5:1028428005:1.source_cn: 放心，刚才他都交代了，我会让巡游队平安送你的孩子回家。

choice_prompt:6:1028428005.text: Don't worry, he's confessed to everything. I assure you your child will return home safely.
choice_prompt:6:1028428005.source_cn: 放心，刚才他都交代了，我会让巡游队平安送你的孩子回家。

say:7:1028428006:1.text: He forced my hand into researching corruption in the forest. It seems he used magic to disguise himself as a Wilder and slipped through the blockade right past the Thorned Guards.
say:7:1028428006:1.source_cn: 我……我被他胁迫去林场做研究。他好像用了什么法术，伪装...

say:8:1028428007:3.text: Not long after we'd begun, the Harvesters arrived, disrupting our plans in an instant.
say:8:1028428007:3.source_cn: 研究开始没过多久，采集队的人来了，一下子打乱了我们的计划。

say:9:1028428008:1.text: I wanted to use the opportunity to leave and stop the destruction of the forest! But he threatened me with my child and brought me here, saying we'd continue with the experiments once the others left.
say:9:1028428008:1.source_cn: 我本来想趁机离开，停止对林场的破坏！可他用孩子威胁……...

say:10:1028428009:1.text: I tried to resist, but in our scuffle, the scoundrel knocked me unconscious...
say:10:1028428009:1.source_cn: 我想反抗，但在争斗中，反而被他打晕了……

say:11:1028428010:1.text: That reminds me! How are the Harvesters doing?!
say:11:1028428010:1.source_cn: ——对了！那些采集队员！他们的身体怎么样了？！

choice_prompt:12:1028428010.text: That reminds me! How are the Harvesters doing?!
choice_prompt:12:1028428010.source_cn: ——对了！那些采集队员！他们的身体怎么样了？！

say:13:1028428011:0.text: That's good to hear... We're all fortunate you arrived.

say:14:1028428012:0.text: Healing herbs were also affected by the corruption and I was afraid they wouldn't recover.
say:14:1028428012:0.source_cn: 嗯，林场被腐化后，恐怕附近的药草也受到部分影响，无法完...

say:16:1028428015:2.text: Take this, it's a <style="highlight">soothing remedy</style> I prepared in the forest before all the corruption began. I think it'll help the Harvesters.
say:16:1028428015:2.source_cn: 收下吧，这是我在林场被腐化之前，偷偷采集配置的<sty...

say:17:1028428016:1.text: ...It's all my fault. Oh, what have I done? I've tainted the forest!
say:17:1028428016:1.source_cn: ……都是我的错，我都做了什么啊，把森林破坏成那个样子……！！

say:18:1028428017:1.text: I'm just so terribly sorry... please, forgive me!
say:18:1028428017:1.source_cn: 对不起，请原谅我……请原谅我！！

choice_prompt:19:1028428017.text: I'm just so terribly sorry... please, forgive me!
choice_prompt:19:1028428017.source_cn: 对不起，请原谅我……请原谅我！！

say:20:1028428018:0.text: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> says so, then it must be true! Please rest assured.
say:20:1028428018:0.male: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> says so, then it must be true! Please rest assured.
say:20:1028428018:0.female: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> says so, then it must be true! Please rest assured.

say:21:1028428019:1.text: As long as there's no more foul play, things should return to normal. The forest's thriving life force coupled with the magic of <style="stress"><player_name></style> should dispel any further hints of corruption!
say:21:1028428019:1.source_cn: 只要没有人为推动，情况就不会继续恶化，丛林旺盛的生命力...
say:21:1028428019:1.male: As long as there's no more foul play, things should return to normal. The forest's thriving life force coupled with the magic of <style="stress"><player_name></style> should dispel any further hints of corruption!
say:21:1028428019:1.female: As long as there's no more foul play, things should return to normal. The forest's thriving life force coupled with the magic of <style="stress"><player_name></style> should dispel any further hints of corruption!

say:22:1028428020:1.text: Please don't be so hard on yourself. The Adamant Syndicate gave you little choice.
say:22:1028428020:1.source_cn: 嗯，请您别太自责，毕竟您也受到了黑金商会的胁迫。

say:23:1028428021:1.text: Believe in our home, in it's strength... this place will always be teeming with vitality and life, won't it?
say:23:1028428021:1.source_cn: 相信我们的家园吧，我们生活的地方，始终充满了勃勃的生机...

say:24:1028428022:1.text: You're right, we have a magnificent homeland.
say:24:1028428022:1.source_cn: 你说得对，我们有一片伟大的森林……

say:25:1028428023:1.text: Let's wait for the Dusk Patrollers to arrive. We still have matters to attend to.
say:25:1028428023:1.source_cn: 那么，接下来就等巡游队的队员赶到吧。我们还有事要处理呢。

narration:26:1028428024:1.text: Soon after, members of the Dusk Patrollers arrived.

say:28:1028428025:1.text: Take them away, and remember to guard this so-called "herbalist" of the Adamant Syndicate. Bind his hands extra tight!
say:28:1028428025:1.source_cn: 把他们带走吧。对了，记得把这位黑金商会的“植物学家”看...

say:30:1028428027:1.text: As for you, sir, rest assured that your child will be returned to you. But...
say:30:1028428027:1.source_cn: 学者先生，请放心吧，他们一定会把你的孩子送回家的。但你……

say:31:1028428028:1.text: I know... I'll take responsibility for my part in this and I promise to make amends.
say:31:1028428028:1.source_cn: 我……我知道，我会承担应该承担的责任，想办法弥补我犯的错……

say:32:1028428029:1.text: You have my apologies and sincerest thanks.

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 幸好那些腐化并不严重

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我们想办法缓解了症状

say:35:1028428013:1.text: We found some herbs for them! They can help, but won't cure their symptoms outright.
say:35:1028428013:1.source_cn: 我们给他们找了药草！不过只能缓解他们的症状，没法彻底治愈。

say:36:1028428014:0.text: But they do seem a bit better.
say:36:1028428014:0.source_cn: 不过，他们看起来已经好一些了。

say:0:1028428101:0.text: Magister, let's tell the Harvesters about the herbalist!
say:0:1028428101:0.source_cn: 主人，我们赶紧去把植物学家的下落告诉伐木队的人吧！
say:0:1028428101:0.male: Magister, let's tell the Harvesters about the herbalist!
say:0:1028428101:0.female: Magister, let's tell the Harvesters about the herbalist!

say:1:1028429001:1.text: Welcome back! Have you found the missing herbalists? Are they safe?
say:1:1028429001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了，找到那两个失踪的植物学家了吗？他们还安全吗？！

say:4:1028429003:1.text: So we were being used! Alas, my comrades suffered for nothing...
say:4:1028429003:1.source_cn: 原来我们是被利用了！唉，让队员们平白受了不少苦……

say:5:1028429004:1.text: Hmph, that Adamant Syndicate snake should know what it's like to fall so ill!
say:5:1028429004:1.source_cn: 哼，应该让黑金商会那家伙也尝尝被腐蚀生病的滋味！

choice_prompt:6:1028429004.text: Hmph, that Adamant Syndicate snake should know what it's like to fall so ill!
choice_prompt:6:1028429004.source_cn: 哼，应该让黑金商会那家伙也尝尝被腐蚀生病的滋味！

say:7:1028429005:1.text: Thank you all! I was worried not everyone would make it back to the village, but now I feel relieved.
say:7:1028429005:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们！我刚才还担心大家撑不到回村子呢，这下就放心了。

say:8:1028429006:1.text: I just hope when we return, those waiting for lumber won't be too angry...
say:8:1028429006:1.source_cn: 只希望回到村子以后，那些等着用梁木的村民们别太生气……

say:9:1028429007:1.text: Ah, right! The old man in the village is still waiting to build his new home!
say:9:1028429007:1.source_cn: ——啊，对哦！村里准备翻盖房子的大叔还在等着呢！

say:10:1028429008:1.text: I'll send out another team. As long as there are no more mishaps, there will still be enough timber to go around before the rainy season.
say:10:1028429008:1.source_cn: 我会再派出一支采集队。只要不再出现意外，雨季前还来得及...

say:11:1028429009:1.text: It's unfortunate how much devastation the corruption caused.
say:11:1028429009:1.source_cn: 可惜，林地又是被砍伐，又是被腐化，现在看上去满目疮痍。

say:12:1028429010:1.text: I failed to complete our task, and now the forest is in such a poor state.
say:12:1028429010:1.source_cn: 我没能带队完成这次的任务，反而把林场破坏成了这个样子……

say:14:1028429011:1.text: But it's not your fault! You led with bravery and took on a lot of responsibility. That's commendable in and of itself.
say:14:1028429011:1.source_cn: 但这不是你的错！你能果断下令和勇于承担责任，已经做得很好了！

say:15:1028429012:1.text: Captain, you should have more faith in our homeland. Look!
say:15:1028429012:1.source_cn: 队长先生，你应该对我们的家园有更大的信心呀。你瞧——

say:16:1028429013:2.text: Even though trunks are all that remain of some of our trees, their roots remain firmly in the soil. Still alive, still growing...
say:16:1028429013:2.source_cn: 林场中的树木，即使树干被砍伐了，根系都还牢牢地扎在土壤...

say:17:1028429014:1.text: Wounds will heal, and life will begin anew.
say:17:1028429014:1.source_cn: 而新芽总会从旧木上长出。

say:18:1028429015:1.text: Fear not, soon enough this forest will be towering with trees once more.
say:18:1028429015:1.source_cn: 放心吧，终有一天，这里会重新长满参天大树。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1028406101:.text: Everyone, quiet! I think I heard something...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1028406101:.source_cn: 大家静一静，我似乎听到了什么声音……
